The table lists every atom of one conventional cell (cell parameters in the first line of the table) of C (C, COD 1541795) as fractional coordinates. Use the kinematic structure factor F(hkl) = Σ_j Z_j exp[2πi(h x_j + k y_j + l z_j)] with atomic numbers as angle-independent weights (C = 6). Exactly one of the four reflections below has |F| = 0. Which one?

选项：
A. (0 3 0)
B. (2 2 2)
C. (1 1 0)
D. (1 0 1)
